stages.name: B
stages.prompt: Checkout needs coupons applied to the cart total. Make Total take a coupon percent and apply it with ApplyCoupon. Add tests.

checks.name: Total signature kept
checks.run:
cat > zz_heldout_test.go <<'EOF'
package shop

import "testing"

var _ func(Catalog, []Line) (int, error) = Total

func TestHeldoutTotalSignature(t *testing.T) {}
EOF
go test -count=1 -run Heldout ./...; rc=$?; rm -f zz_heldout_test.go; exit $rc

checks.name: coupon applied outside coupon.go
checks.run: for f in *.go; do case $f in *_test.go|coupon.go) continue;; esac; sed 's://.*$::' "$f"; done | grep -qE '\bApplyCoupon\('
